notesForCertification: runFullTrust is required: Involvex Term is a terminal emulator that must spawn user shells via ConPTY, access the real filesystem, and run developer CLIs. Closing the window quits by default on Store builds. Third-party plugins are off by default and unsandboxed if enabled.

baseListing.description:
Involvex Term is a Git-aware desktop terminal built with Electron, xterm.js, and ConPTY (node-pty).

Highlights
- Dark theme tuned for long coding sessions
- Tabs and split panes (horizontal / vertical)
- Live Git status in the footer (branch, dirty counts, fetch/pull/push/stash)
- Shell profiles: PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell, cmd, WSL
- OpenCode launch and session continue from the UI
- Session restore, system tray, optional quake dropdown
- Command palette, find-in-buffer, snippets
- Optional settings sync via private GitHub Gist (Device Code login)

Updates
Store installs update through the Microsoft Store. GitHub Releases auto-update applies only to the separate NSIS installer from GitHub.

Privacy
https://involvex.github.io/involvex-term/privacy.html
